ConsoleEndpoint.description: A new endpoint as the website API takes it, plus the mode: a website's key carries it, a person chooses it.

HolderKey.description:
The public half of a key pair the browser made for one pass: an EC key on P-256, as a JWK, and nothing more —
a private part (`d`) or anything else is refused.
HolderKey.title: HolderKey

NewPasskey.description:
A device's answer to `navigator.credentials.create`, with the password (and a current code, if one-time codes
are on): adding a way in needs more than a signed-in browser.

PasswordChange.description: The current password, the new one, and a current code if one-time codes are on (decision D31).

Problem.description: The shape of every refusal (RFC 9457), described once so the published API document can show it.

ProjectChange.description: A new name, a new list of allowed origins (replacing the old one), or both.
ProjectChange.title: ProjectChange

Reauthentication.description: The password and a current code: proof that the person, not just their browser, is asking.
Reauthentication.title: Reauthentication
